name: @kitora/feedback
description: Kitora's feedback kit: toasts (queue, stacking, swipe, pause, undo, promise, dedupe, positions) with an imperative API and a provider, a notification inbox with a bell, banners and inline alerts (on the ui Alert primitive), progress, the stepper (Stepper parts, Steps and StepProgress), spinners, skeletons, empty states and result pages, on a framework-free core.

exports.name: defaultToastPriority
exports.description:
How urgently a toast is announced: `high` interrupts (an assertive `role="alert"` copy, as the primitives' `Toast.Viewport` does), `low` waits for a pause (the polite
list). Errors default to `high`, every other type to `low` ({@link defaultToastPriority}).

exports.name: defaultDedupeKey
exports.description: The default dedupe key: same type, title and description means the same message.

exports.name: createToastStore
exports.description:
A toast store whose content is `N` (default `string`). The second, non-generic signature is only there so `ReturnType<typeof createToastStore>` stays
`ToastStore<string>` (TypeScript reads the last overload), as it was before the store took a content type.

exports.name: ToastClock
exports.description: The timer seam, so tests (and a host with its own scheduler) drive time.

exports.name: ToastPriority
exports.description: One of `TOAST_PRIORITIES`.

exports.name: TOAST_TYPES

exports.name: ToastType
exports.description: One of {@link TOAST_TYPES}.

exports.name: TOAST_POSITIONS

exports.name: ToastPosition
exports.description: One of {@link TOAST_POSITIONS}.

exports.name: DEFAULT_DURATIONS
exports.description:
How long each type stays up, in ms. Errors and warnings stay longer because
they usually need reading; loading stays until its promise settles.

exports.name: DEFAULT_EXIT_MS
exports.description: Time a dismissed toast spends in `leaving` before it is removed, matching the exit transition.

exports.name: ToastAction
exports.description: A button on a toast. The toast closes after `onClick` unless `keepOpen` is set.

exports.name: DISMISS_REASONS

exports.name: DismissReason

exports.name: TOAST_STATES
exports.description:
`queued` waits for a slot (the position already shows `max`), `active` is
on screen with a running or paused timer, `leaving` is animating out.

exports.name: ToastState
exports.description: One of {@link TOAST_STATES}.

exports.name: Toast
exports.description: One toast as the store holds it; immutable, replaced on every change.

exports.name: OVERFLOW_POLICIES
exports.description:
What happens when a position already shows `max` toasts: `queue` holds the
new one until a slot frees (nothing is lost), `drop-oldest` dismisses the
oldest on screen so the newest is always visible.

exports.name: OverflowPolicy
exports.description: One of {@link OVERFLOW_POLICIES}.

exports.name: ToastStoreOptions
exports.description: How a toast store from {@link createToastStore} behaves: where toasts stack, how many show, how long they stay.

exports.name: ToastPatch
exports.description: Fields `update` may change; the rest of a toast is fixed at creation. A type change without a `priority` takes the new type's default priority.

exports.name: ToastMessage
exports.description: A promise-toast message: fixed text, or text computed from the settled value.

exports.name: PromiseMessages
exports.description: Messages for a promise toast: a string, or a function of the settled value.

exports.name: ToastStore
exports.description: A toast store from {@link createToastStore}: the toasts and the calls that raise, update, dismiss and time them.

exports.name: STACK_PEEK_PX
exports.description: Pixels each older toast peeks out behind the front one while collapsed.

exports.name: STACK_GAP_PX
exports.description: Gap between toasts while expanded.

exports.name: STACK_SCALE_STEP
exports.description: How much smaller each older toast is drawn while collapsed (5% per step).

exports.name: STACK_VISIBLE
exports.description: Older toasts that peek out while collapsed; the rest are hidden but stay mounted.

exports.name: StackInput
exports.description: What {@link stackLayout} takes: the toasts' measured heights, newest first, and whether the stack is expanded.

exports.name: StackSlot
exports.description: Where one toast of a stack sits: its offset, scale and whether it is shown.

props.name: offset
props.description: Distance from the stack's edge (bottom for bottom positions, top for top), px.

props.name: scale
props.description: The scale the toast is drawn at (1 in front or expanded).

props.name: opacity

exports.description: The result of {@link stackLayout}: one slot per toast plus the stack's total height.

exports.description: The layout of one position's stack: collapsed (peeking) or expanded (a column).

exports.name: resolveSwipeDirections
exports.description: The directions a toast at `position` takes for `option`; `coarse` is whether the primary pointer is coarse (a touch screen). Pure, so it is tested without a device.
exports.signature: (option: ToastSwipeOption, position: string, coarse: boolean) => readonly ToastSwipeDirection[]

exports.name: SWIPE_DISTANCE_RATIO
exports.description: Fraction of the toast's width a slow drag must cover to dismiss.

exports.name: SWIPE_VELOCITY
exports.description: A flick faster than this (px per ms) dismisses even when short.

exports.name: SWIPE_MIN_PX
exports.description: A flick must still travel this far, so a tap with jitter never dismisses.

exports.name: SWIPE_OUTCOMES
exports.description: What a swipe on release can lead to: the toast is dismissed or snaps back.

exports.name: SwipeOutcome
exports.description: One of {@link SWIPE_OUTCOMES}.

exports.name: SwipeSample
exports.description: One swipe as a renderer measures it on release: distance, duration and the toast's width.

exports.name: swipeOutcome
exports.description: Whether a released swipe dismisses the toast: a drag past {@link SWIPE_DISTANCE_RATIO} of its width, or a quick flick of at least {@link SWIPE_MIN_PX}.

exports.name: swipeOpacity
exports.description: Opacity while dragging: fades out as the toast nears the dismiss distance.

exports.name: swipeOutcomeBySpeed
exports.description: The same rule for a gesture that reports its own average speed (px per ms), as the primitives' shared swipe does.
exports.signature: (sample: { readonly dx: number; readonly speed: number; readonly width: number; }) => SwipeOutcome

exports.name: TOAST_SWIPE_DIRECTIONS
exports.description: The directions a kit toast can be swiped away in: the two lateral ones and the two vertical edges.

exports.name: ToastSwipeDirection
exports.description: One of {@link TOAST_SWIPE_DIRECTIONS}.

exports.name: LATERAL_SWIPE_DIRECTIONS
exports.description: Today's gesture: a sideways swipe in either direction.

exports.name: ToastSwipeOption
exports.description:
A toaster's `swipeDirections` option: a fixed list, or `"auto"`, which is the lateral pair plus the edge the stack sits on (down for a bottom stack, up for a top
one) under a coarse pointer, the way a phone user flicks a notification off the screen (Sonner's, Base UI's `swipeDirection`). Opt-in: the default stays lateral.

exports.name: openUndoWindow
exports.description: Opens an undo window: exactly one of `commit` (after `delay` or on `flush`) or `undo` runs, once.
exports.signature: ({ delay, commit, undo, setTimeout: set, clearTimeout: clear }: UndoWindowOptions) => UndoWindow

exports.name: UndoWindowOptions
exports.description: What {@link openUndoWindow} runs and when: the commit, the undo and how long the window stays open.

exports.name: UNDO_OUTCOMES
exports.description: Where an undo window stands: still open, committed, or undone.

exports.name: UndoOutcome
exports.description: One of {@link UNDO_OUTCOMES}.

exports.name: UndoWindow
exports.description: An open undo window from {@link openUndoWindow}.

exports.name: memoryInboxStorage
exports.description: The default storage: keeps nothing, so the seed is the inbox on every load.

exports.name: keyValueInboxStorage
exports.description:
An {@link InboxStorage} over any {@link KeyValueStorage}, as JSON under one
key. Unreadable or foreign data reads as "nothing saved" (the seed wins)
rather than throwing, and a failing write (quota, private mode) is dropped:
an inbox that cannot persist still works for the session.

exports.name: connectInbox
exports.description: Feeds every notification a source pushes into the store; returns the disconnect.

exports.name: createInboxStore
exports.description:
A notification store. `initial` seeds it when the storage has nothing saved;
once the storage has a saved list, that list wins (a read stays read after a reload).

exports.name: unreadCount
exports.description: How many notifications are unread, in all groups or only in `group`.

exports.name: badgeLabel
exports.description: The bell badge text: nothing at 0, the number up to `max`, then `max+`.

exports.name: groupByDay
exports.description: Buckets newest-first notifications into Today / Yesterday / This week / Earlier, dropping empty buckets; days in `timeZone` (the system's when omitted).
exports.signature: (items: readonly InboxNotification[], now: number, timeZone?: string) => readonly { readonly label: DayGroup; readonly items: readonly InboxNotification[]; }[]

exports.name: relativeTime
exports.description: "now", "5m", "3h", "2d", then a short date (in `locale` and `timeZone`, the runtime's when omitted): the compact relative time the centre shows.
exports.signature: (ms: number, now: number, locale?: string, timeZone?: string) => string

exports.name: InboxNotification
exports.description: One notification. `group` is the host's category ("mentions", "deploys"), shown as a filter tab.

exports.name: InboxStore
exports.description: A notification store from {@link createInboxStore}: the list, newest first, and the changes a centre makes to it.

exports.name: InboxStorage
exports.description:
The persistence seam: where an inbox keeps its notifications between page
loads. `load` runs once when the store is created (undefined = nothing
saved yet, use the seed); `save` runs after every change. The default is
{@link memoryInboxStorage} (nothing survives a reload); the dom layer ships
`localInboxStorage`, and a host plugs in IndexedDB or a server the same way.

exports.name: KeyValueStorage
exports.description:
The smallest key-value shape `localStorage`, `sessionStorage` and most
mobile storage shims share, so {@link keyValueInboxStorage} stays DOM-free.

exports.name: InboxSource
exports.description:
The transport seam: where new notifications come from (a WebSocket, SSE, a
poll, a push channel). `connect` receives a `push` callback and returns a
disconnect function. {@link connectInbox} wires one to a store.

exports.name: InboxStoreOptions
exports.description: How {@link createInboxStore} persists its notifications.

exports.name: DAY_GROUPS
exports.description: The day buckets {@link groupByDay} sorts notifications into, newest first.

exports.name: DayGroup
exports.description: One of {@link DAY_GROUPS}.

exports.name: InboxTimeFormatter
exports.description: The formatter seam for a row's time label; {@link relativeTime} is the default.

exports.signature: (done: number, total: number, bytesPerSecond: number) => string

exports.signature: (count: number, active: number, flags?: StepFlags) => readonly StepState[]

exports.description: Whether step `index` may be opened from `active` under `navigation`.
exports.signature: (index: number, active: number, states: readonly StepState[], navigation: StepperNavigation) => boolean

exports.name: STEP_STATES
exports.description: Every visual state a step can be in, as {@link stepStates} resolves it.

exports.name: StepState
exports.description: One of {@link STEP_STATES}.

exports.name: STEPPER_ORIENTATIONS
exports.description: The directions a stepper lays its steps out in.

exports.name: StepperOrientation
exports.description: One of {@link STEPPER_ORIENTATIONS}.

exports.name: STEPPER_NAVIGATION
exports.description:
`linear`: a step can be opened once every step before it is complete (and you
can always go back); `free`: any step that is not disabled.

exports.name: StepperNavigation
exports.description: One of {@link STEPPER_NAVIGATION}.

exports.name: StepFlags
exports.description: What the host knows about the steps beyond the active index: which are complete, errored or disabled, and whether the flow is done.

exports.name: DEFAULT_METER_MAX
exports.description: The default `max` (see {@link MeterRange.max}).

exports.name: meterState
exports.description: The resolved range with its percentage (clamped: the value is) and zone.

exports.name: meterZone
METER_ZONES
exports.description: The three regions of a meter's range, best first (HTML calls the last one "even less good").

exports.name: percentMeterFormat
exports.description: The default: the rounded percent of the range ("62%").

exports.name: resolveMeter
exports.description:
Resolves the boundaries the way the HTML spec does: `max` below `min` becomes
`min`; `value` and `optimum` clamp into [min, max]; `low` clamps into
[min, max]; `high` clamps into [low, max]. A NaN or missing value reads as min.

exports.name: MeterFormatter
exports.description:
Turns a meter's state into the text a screen reader hears (aria-valuetext)
and the Value part shows: "7.2 GB of 10 GB", "Strong", "62%". The seam for
units and locales.

exports.name: MeterRange
exports.description: A meter's inputs; everything but `value` is optional, with the `<meter>` element's defaults.

exports.name: MeterState
exports.description: Everything a meter's parts read, computed once per render.

props.name: percent
props.description: Where the value sits in the range, 0 to 100 (0 when `min` equals `max`).

props.name: zone
props.description: The region the value is in.

props.name: value
props.description: The value, clamped to `min`..`max`.

props.name: min
props.description: The low end of the range.

props.name: max
props.description: The high end of the range, never below `min`.

props.name: low
props.description: The upper end of the low region, clamped to the range.

props.name: high
props.description: The lower end of the high region, clamped to `low`..`max`.

props.name: optimum
props.description: The best value, clamped to the range.

exports.name: MeterZone
exports.description: One of `METER_ZONES`: `optimum`, `suboptimal` or `critical`.

exports.name: ResolvedMeter
exports.description: A range with every boundary resolved and clamped, as the HTML algorithm does before it compares.

exports.name: trickleStep
exports.description: The next trickle value: a tenth of the way to the ceiling, at least `MIN_TRICKLE_STEP`, never past `MAX_LOADING_VALUE`.

exports.name: createTopProgress
exports.description: A top progress store; `topProgress` is the shared default one.
exports.signature: ({ initial, trickle, stepInterval, fadeMs, timer }?: TopProgressOptions) => TopProgressStore

exports.name: TopProgressPhase
exports.description: The bar's phase: `idle` (not shown), `loading`, or `done` (full, fading out).

props.name: phase
props.description: Whether the bar is idle, loading or done.

exports.name: TopProgressTimer
exports.description: The clock the store runs on; inject a fake in tests.

exports.name: TopProgressOptions
exports.description: How a top progress bar from {@link createTopProgress} starts, trickles and fades, and the clock it runs on.

exports.name: TopProgressStore
exports.description: A top progress bar from {@link createTopProgress}: start, move and finish it, and read its state.

exports.name: TRICKLE_CEILING
exports.description: Trickling slows toward this value and the bar only passes it in small steps.

exports.description: The highest value while loading: only `done()` or `set(100)` fills the bar.

exports.description: The shared store: `topProgress.start()` from anywhere shows the `<TopProgress />` that follows it.

exports.description: Pauses `store` while `doc` is hidden; returns the unbind (which also resumes).

exports.name: HIDDEN_PAUSE_REASON
exports.description: Pause reason the visibility binding uses; distinct so hover and focus pauses stack with it.

exports.description: The first visible toast inside the first region, or undefined when no region shows one.

exports.name: focusFirstToast
exports.description: Focuses {@link firstFocusableToast}; true when something took focus.

exports.name: TOAST_HOTKEY
exports.description: Default key that moves focus into the toasts.

exports.name: FOCUSABLE_TOAST_SELECTOR
exports.description: Selector of a focusable toast inside a region (hidden peeking toasts are skipped).

exports.name: flushOnPageHide
exports.description: Flushes `win` on the window's `pagehide`; returns the unbind (call it once the window settles).

exports.name: localInboxStorage
exports.description: Persists an inbox in `storage` (default `localStorage`) under `key`.

exports.name: createToaster
exports.description: Creates a toaster with its own store; scope it to a subtree with `<ToastProvider>`. The app-wide one is `toast`.

exports.name: ReactToast
exports.description: A toast as the React layer holds it: its title and description are React nodes.

exports.name: ReactToastInput
exports.description: What `toast.message` takes: a {@link ToastInput} whose content is React nodes.

exports.name: ToastOptions
exports.description: Options for a typed shortcut: everything but the title and type.

exports.name: UndoableOptions
exports.description: Options for `toast.undoable`, the confirm-free destructive pattern.

exports.name: UNDONE_TOAST_MS
exports.description: How long the "Restored" confirmation stays up, ms.

exports.name: ToasterApi

exports.name: toast
exports.description:
The app-wide toaster behind the bare `toast()` import and a bare

escape hatch for apps that want their own instance (tests, iframes, panels).

props.name: children
props.description: The subtree that uses `toaster`.

exports.description: The nearest toaster: the provider's, else the app-wide one.

exports.name: useToasts
exports.description: Every toast in a toaster (all positions, including queued and leaving ones), re-rendering on change.

exports.name: useCoarsePointer
exports.description: Whether the primary pointer is coarse (a touch screen), following changes (a tablet docked to a keyboard); false where `matchMedia` is missing (a server, jsdom).

exports.name: useToasterBindings
exports.description:
Wires a toaster to the page: pauses every timer while the tab is hidden and
binds the focus hotkey (`null` turns it off) through
exports.signature: (toaster: ToasterApi, hotkey?: string | null) => (position: ToastPosition) => (el: HTMLElement | null) => void

exports.name: useToastPositions
exports.description: Positions that currently show at least one toast, in {@link TOAST_POSITIONS} order.

exports.name: isBottomPosition
exports.description: Whether a toast position sits on the bottom edge of the screen.

exports.name: FOCUS_TOASTS_COMMAND
exports.description: Prefix of the focus-toasts command each toaster registers with the keyboard kit.
